name: Physics of Fluids
description: Structure of liquids. Hydrostatics. Euler and Lagrangian frames of reference. Vorticity. Conservation of mass, momentum, and energy in a fluid flow. Euler equation. Kelvin’s circulation theorem. Boundary layers. Potential flow. Compressible flows and waves. Viscosity. Navier Stokes equation. Low Reynolds number flows. Stokes equation. Hydrodynamic instabilities. Turbulence.
